description: Risk-based visual-state inventory template for consumer installed production captures. Each state drives the installed product binary through real input dispatch to a semantically reachable window state. Captures are exact-commit, installed-path, serial and isolated. Consumers must replace these placeholder states with their product's actual visual states before enabling visual audit.

states.expected: Primary window renders its main content list with rows, status line, and controls

navigation: activate the secondary view via the primary input
states.expected: Secondary view shows a selected row with highlight and the summary column

navigation: open the detail editor via the primary input
states.expected: Detail editor renders its diagram region, highlighted item, model label, and content list
Dialog window renders its icon/status content in an active state
